title: Recommendation (v1.0.0)
description: A regulation recommendation produced by the backend decision engine. Data persists it in the gold layer. The dispatcher must approve before any on-road action is taken (Principle IV). Screen US-05. See ADR-0003.

schema_version.description: Read contract version (SemVer). Turn 1 produces only 1.0.0.

rec_id.description: UUID v4 uniquely identifying this recommendation.

case.description: Regulation case. C1: bunching → hold. C2: gap → adjust departure. C5: breakdown → reserve dispatch. D1: source outage → information only, no alert.

type.description: Action type. hold: keep bus at stop for duration_s. adjust_departure: depart stop early by duration_s. reserve_dispatch: dispatch a reserve bus from the depot.

stop_id.description: Stop where the action should be executed.

duration_s.description: Duration in seconds. hold: 0..90 s (positive delay at stop). adjust_departure: -600..600 s (negative = depart earlier, positive = depart later). reserve_dispatch: always null.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this recommendation was generated. Frontend displays this to the dispatcher.

ewt_saving_s.description: Projected reduction in Excess Wait Time in seconds if the action is applied. Positive = improvement.

horizon_s.description: Time horizon in seconds over which the ewt_saving_s projection is computed.

data_quality.description: Data quality of the snapshot used to generate this recommendation.

expires_ts.description: UTC timestamp after which this recommendation is no longer actionable. Status transitions to 'expired' automatically.

conflicts_with.description: List of rec_id values that are mutually exclusive with this recommendation. Backend detects conflicts.

rank.description: Priority rank among concurrent recommendations. 1 = highest priority.

status.description: Lifecycle status. proposed: awaiting dispatcher decision. applied: dispatcher approved (command_event written). discarded: dispatcher rejected. expired: past expires_ts with no decision.

lineage.description: Traceability fields linking this recommendation to the data and rules that produced it.

model_version.description: Version of the M1/M2 baseline models used (SemVer string).

rule_version.description: Version of the decision rules applied (SemVer string). Matches the rules_version on gold rows.

snapshot_id.description: UUID v4 of the corridor_now snapshot that triggered this recommendation.
